_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Abou ta Hungadó {player_id} den e wega di LinesOfAction.
Bo piesanan ta '{side}', e piesanan di e kontrahent ta '{other}'.
Formato di move: `[b1b3]` (koordinátnan di origen pa koordinátnan di destinashon). Un move legal ta viaja horizontalmente, vertikalmente, òf diagonalmente un kantidat di kuadrátnan igual na e total di piesanan (di kualke koló) den e línea. Abou por salta riba bo piesanan propio, pero no riba e piesanan di e kontrahent; aterisando riba un kontrahent ta kaptur'é.  Gana ora tur bo piesanan ta konektá den 8-vizindario.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E forma mester ta e2e4 (for di, pa koordinatanan).
invalid_move.identical: E origen i e destinashon ta identiko.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: E moveshon mester ta direkto òf diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Mester move e distansia igual na piezanan den liña.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: E arma enemigo ta blokia e kaminda.
invalid_move.destination_own: Destino okupá pa su mes arma.

game_action.captured_suffix: Player {player_id} a movi {from} -> {to} capturando un enemigo.

outcome.draw_repetition: E posishon a ser ripiti tres biaha.
